title: CreateBdsInstanceDetails
description: The information about the new cluster.

bootstrapScriptUrl.description: Pre-authenticated URL of the script in Object Store that is downloaded and executed.

clusterAdminPassword.description: Base-64 encoded password for the cluster (and Cloudera Manager) admin user. Not required if the secretId is specified.

clusterProfile.description: Profile of the Big Data Service cluster.

clusterPublicKey.description: The SSH public key used to authenticate the cluster connection.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer and boolean types are supported.

Key-value pair representing predefined tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
For example, `{"bar-key": "value"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
For example, `{"foo-namespace": {"bar-key": "value"}}`

displayName.description: Name of the Big Data Service cluster.

freeformTags.description:
Simple key-value pair that is applied without any predefined name, type, or scope.
Exists for cross-compatibility only. For example, `{"bar-key": "value"}`

isHighAvailability.description: Boolean flag specifying whether or not the cluster is highly available (HA).

isSecretReused.description: Boolean flag specifying whether or not to persist the provided secret OCID and reuse it for future operations.

isSecure.description: Boolean flag specifying whether or not the cluster should be set up as secure.

kmsKeyId.description: The OCID of the Key Management master encryption key.

nodes.description: The list of nodes in the Big Data Service cluster.

BdsClusterVersionSummary.description: Cluster version details including bds and odh version information.

bdsVersion.description: BDS version to be used for cluster creation

odhVersion.description: ODH version to be used for cluster creation

CreateNodeDetails.description: The information about the new node.

blockVolumeSizeInGBs.description:
The size of block volume in GB to be attached to a given node. All the
details needed for attaching the block volume are managed by service itself.

nodeType.description: The Big Data Service cluster node type.

subnetId.description: The OCID of the subnet in which the node will be created.

NetworkConfig.description: Additional configuration of the user's network.

cidrBlock.description: The CIDR IP address block of the VCN.

isNatGatewayRequired.description: A boolean flag whether to configure a NAT gateway.

ShapeConfigDetails.description: The shape configuration requested for the node.

memoryInGBs.description: The total amount of memory available to the node, in gigabytes.

nvmes.description: The number of NVMe drives to be used for storage. A single drive has 6.8 TB available.

ocpus.description: The total number of OCPUs available to the node.
